name: Product Margin Report
purpose: Calculates the profit margin of every product in the catalog, grouped by category and brand

inputs.sku: Item code the company uses for the product
inputs.category: Main category the product belongs to
inputs.pack_size: Amount in one pack, e.g. 500g or 1L
inputs.selling_price: Price the product is sold to customers for
inputs.unit_cost: What the company pays to buy one unit of the product
inputs.launch_date: Date the product was first put on sale
inputs.supplier_code: Code of the supplier the product is bought from
inputs.hs_code: Customs tariff code used when the product is imported
inputs.size_variant: Size of this version of the product, such as a clothing size, shoe size or pipe diameter
inputs.lifecycle_status: Whether the product is still sold, being phased out or discontinued
inputs.size_system: Sizing system the shoe sizes use: UK, US or EU
